evidence_type: REPLAY of stored real outcomes (not new real observations)
independent_real_cli_runs_note: This harness never executes the Claude CLI. Every number here replays recorded outcomes; independent real CLI runs are produced only by caver8.live and are NOT part of this report.
replay_caveat: Replay draws the same 30 recorded outcomes ([1] per configuration) again and again. Seed CIs capture schedule and policy randomness only, NOT the uncertainty of the recorded observations themselves.
budget: 90 train + 90 eval probes per run (asserted by run_one)
ci: paired, mean +/- 1.96 sd/sqrt(n) on matched seeds
recovery: restricted mean (censored events counted at the cap), censoring rate, KM median
cpu_note: CPU us/probe is process CPU time in select+update; noisy, order of magnitude only
